actions.name: OLDER_ACQUISITION_READ
actions.sideEffect: SELECT only; preserve all ERP ledgers, manual values and confirmed revisions. Same-year last purchase outside four-week FIFO window, exact purchase-period taxable FX, complete same-unit arrival reconstruction. Ecuador, Netherlands, Australia, China and Thailand; context isolated by week AND category/currency. Thai FIFO uses the same purchase-period exact FX reconstruction and requires SQL actual freight/customs under profit-actual-costs: no defaults, partial freight, unmatched goods or price-floor repair. Vietnam category-average unchanged. No future/current-FX/sales-price fallback. Other countries retain their existing policies; reconstruction alone is not certification of actual bills.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 same ProdKey and OrderWeek cannot mix. Beginning and ending valuations each use their own year/week cutoff.
